# Coutume

> Coutume is a free habit tracker for iPhone, in French, English and Spanish. It keeps good habits to build (8 glasses of water, 10,000 steps) and bad ones to quit (energy drinks): habits to build fill a ring in one tap, habits to quit are kept by default and only slips are logged. Apple Health fills in steps, exercise, mindful minutes and water on its own. Streaks forgive one missed day per week, and levels and milestones reward every day kept. No account, no ads: habits are stored on the iPhone and in the user's private iCloud. Made by Wibeset in Canada.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone only (not available on Android or the web). Coming soon to the App Store.
- Price: free, with no ads, no subscription and no account.
- Habits: to build (a check, or a count toward a daily target) or to quit (days without, money saved, urges resisted).
- Apple Health: read only, never written. Steps, exercise minutes, mindful minutes and water; the daily totals stay on the device and in the user's private iCloud.
- Gamification: forgiving streaks (one joker per week), eleven levels by days kept, eighteen milestones, perfect days.
- Widgets: the day's rings on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
- Privacy: no analytics, tracking or server; the developer never receives the user's habits.
- Suite: by the makers of Reliure (reading), Arpente (walking), Porcom (movies and TV) and Dernier Verre (cocktails).

- [Home](https://coutume.app/): features and frequently asked questions
- [Support](https://coutume.app/support/): contact, Health access, steps that don't match, undoing a slip, widgets, archiving
- [Privacy policy](https://coutume.app/privacy/): what information the app handles
- [Streaks alternative](https://coutume.app/streaks-alternative/): compare Coutume with Streaks, the paid habit tracker for Apple devices
- [Habitify alternative](https://coutume.app/habitify-alternative/): compare Coutume with Habitify, the habit tracker with free and paid plans
- [Habitica alternative](https://coutume.app/habitica-alternative/): compare Coutume with Habitica, the habit tracker played as a role-playing game
- [Apple Health habit tracker](https://coutume.app/habit-tracker-apple-health/): steps, exercise, mindful minutes and water, filled in by Apple Health
- [Quit energy drinks](https://coutume.app/quit-energy-drinks/): count your days without energy drinks and the money you save
- [Quit vaping tracker](https://coutume.app/quit-vaping-tracker/): track your days without vaping, the money saved and the urges resisted
- [Days without counter](https://coutume.app/days-without-counter/): a days-without counter for anything you want to quit
- [Water tracker](https://coutume.app/water-tracker/): count your glasses of water in one tap, or let Apple Health do it
- [Free habit tracker](https://coutume.app/free-habit-tracker/): free for real: no subscription, no ads, no account
- [Habit tracker widget](https://coutume.app/habit-tracker-widget/): the day’s rings on your Home Screen and Lock Screen
- [Habit ideas](https://coutume.app/habit-ideas/): 40 ideas of good habits to build and bad ones to quit
- [How long to form a habit](https://coutume.app/how-long-to-form-a-habit/): what research says about the 21-day myth, and why one missed day doesn’t matter
